"''Just keep walking.|Wim and Fern, looking at a dance club with door girls at the entrance||audio=WhatAboutInThere.mp3}} During the [[New Republic Era]], a [[Unidentified four-breasted species|four-breasted alien]] [[Gender|woman]] worked as a '''door girl''' at a [[Borgo Prime]] [[Unidentified dance club|dance club]], performing slow solo dances with flowing body movements to entice passers-by to enter the establishment. ==Biography== At some point by the [[New Republic Era]], a [[Gender|female]] [[alien]] individual of a [[Unidentified four-breasted species|four-breasted species]] had begun a career as a [[door girl]]. Having found employment at a [[Unidentified dance club|dance club]] on the [[pirate]] [[asteroid]] [[Borgo Prime]], the woman was stationed at the entry to the establishment, performing solo dances to entice passers-by to drop by the parlor. [[File:DanceClub-SC-WayOut.png|thumb|right|250px|The door girl worked at a dance club on Borgo Prime.]] Around [[9 ABY]],{{SkeletonCrewDate}} the alien door girl presented a slow solo dance, characterized by flowing movements and intricate hand gestures. Meanwhile, the [[Theelin]] [[Melna]]—another door girl—remained at the other side of the doorway. As their performance unfolded, the dancers attracted a scantily clad [[Twi'lek]] and a [[humanoid]] individual. In addition, the two women were noticed by a group of four [[youngling]]s who had found themselves lost in [[Realspace|space]] following an accidental departure from their [[Homeworld|home planet]] of [[At Attin]].{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}} When the boy [[Wim]] suggested entering the club, the girl [[Fern]] instead insisted on walking somewhere else. Whereas the alien door girl kept dancing, Melna took an interest in the younglings' fate. As she later claimed, a pirate [[Planet|world]] like Borgo Prime was not a good place for younglings. ==Personality and traits== The door girl was an [[Color|light]]-skinned alien of a four-[[breast]]ed [[species]] with loose, dark [[hair]]. A heavyset dancer with prominent abdominal folds, the woman moved slowly and employed flowing body movements. ==Equipment== The door girl's scant [[Clothing|attire]] included a dark, two-piece top and a matching skirt, in addition to jewelry such as a hairband and a necklace. ==Behind the scenes== The door girl first appeared in "[[Way, Way Out Past the Barrier]]," the second episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which premiered on [[December 2]], [[2024]].{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}} ==Appearances== *{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Askajienne non-identifiée |ka=კარის უცნობი გოგონა }} [[Category:Dancers]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
